thought.text: The callback didn't redirect. Let me debug the callback response directly.

reasoning_content: The callback URL seems to have been consumed. The issue is probably the `&` in the URL — I passed it inside double quotes so it should be fine... but `curl` returned redirect_url as empty. Let me check the callback response directly with verbose output.

cd /tmp
curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o cb.html -D cb.headers -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  "http://localhost:3000/oauth2/callback?state=Lr0Hm2qBfYZdP2nksolwd0ySG-KNhhgyZn7XGmPBhys%3A%2Fapp%2F&session_state=440f7bda-bf27-41af-8580-acf88eff7c98&iss=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A9090%2Frealms%2Flocal&code=bf977895-e230-4a3e-93c5-1ebb133312f4.440f7bda-bf27-41af-8580-acf88eff7c98.c64e6eb3-c47e-4f21-8ff4-0111d9f4335b"
